dialogue.speaker: Annette
dialogue.text: That trip took longer than expected, didn't it, Mercie?

dialogue.speaker: Mercedes
dialogue.text: It did. You bought nearly everything in the market.

dialogue.speaker: Annette
dialogue.text: Not everything. And you helped me choose, so that makes it sensible.

dialogue.speaker: Mercedes
dialogue.text: The number of bags you're carrying disagrees.
